patches.name: Android Auto
patches.description: Shows YouTube in Android Auto. What YouTube plays in the background appears on the car screen with play, pause, skip and seek controls. Audio only: Android Auto does not allow video. Needs the background playback patch, and Android Auto's 'Unknown sources' developer setting unless the app was installed by the Play Store.
